title: URL canonicalizer lowercases scheme/host, drops default ports, sorts query
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag decoding and re-encoding the query string as lossy, or leaving path case untouched as incomplete normalisation. Query decode/re-encode is applied identically to every URL so equivalent spellings still collapse to one key, and the contract explicitly preserves path case because paths are case-sensitive on many servers: merging differing-case paths would create false dedup hits.
